file: 220 1 Million People Played One Game of Pokemon.mp4

lines.t: In 2014, over a million people played one game of Pokémon, at the same time.

full.credit: Clips: Twitch Plays Pokemon (icymate; captain Crab; TheGamerFromMars, YouTube)

lines.t: Every chat message was a button press, and over 1.16 million people joined in.

full.credit: Clips: Twitch Plays Pokemon (icymate; captain Crab; TheGamerFromMars, YouTube)

lines.t: It was total chaos. Players kept checking the Helix Fossil, until it became their god, Lord Helix.

full.credit: Clips: Twitch Plays Pokemon (icymate; captain Crab; TheGamerFromMars, YouTube)

lines.t: After 16 days, they actually beat Pokémon Red, and it won a Game Award.
